articles.summary: 11:00 a.m. Eastern Time / 8:00 a.m. Pacific Time Oaktree Specialty Lending Corporation (NASDAQ:OCSL) (“Oaktree Specialty Lending” or the “Company”) today announced that it will report its financial results for the first fiscal quarter ended December 31, 2025 before the opening of the Nasdaq Global Select Market on Wednesday, February 4, 2026.
